\providecommand{\PipCaption}{%
  One apparatus, three lanes, one example task throughout. The starting
  checkpoint and the repository's own recipe are measured rather than assumed,
  and the recipe twice: one configuration, run once at the step count it commits
  to and once at the agent's own twelve hours. Every lane enters from the same
  pinned commit and leaves through the same frozen evaluator. The agent queries
  the fast metric without limit and never sees the final metric that decides its
  score.}
